A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}) AS start_ms,
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  registry AS (
    SELECT row.1 AS kind, row.2 AS scope, toInt64(row.3) AS deadline_sec, row.4 AS closed_by
    FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([
      ('eta.fleet_refresh', 'per_repo', 7200, ''),
      ('eta.backtest.fold', 'fleet_wide', 172800, ''),
      ('eta.fit', 'fleet_wide', 172800, ''),
      ('eta.estimate', 'per_active_repo', 3600, 'eta.outcome')
    ]) AS row)
  ),
  records AS (
    SELECT attributes_string['loom.kind'] AS kind,
           lower(attributes_string['loom.repo']) AS repo,
           attributes_number['loom.issue'] AS issue,
           toInt64(intDiv(timestamp, 1000000)) AS at_ms,
           mapContains(attributes_string, 'loom.eta.no_estimate_reason') AS refused,
           attributes_string['loom.eta.kind'] AS eta_kind
    FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
    WHERE timestamp >= toUInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000
      AND timestamp < toUInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000
      AND attributes_string['loom.kind'] IN (
        SELECT kind FROM registry UNION ALL SELECT closed_by FROM registry WHERE closed_by != '')
  ),
  roster AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(attributes_string['loom.repo']) AS repo
    FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
    WHERE timestamp >= toUInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000
      AND timestamp < toUInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000
      AND attributes_string['loom.kind'] IN ('pass.summary', 'role_tick.outcome', 'sweep.started')
      AND attributes_string['loom.repo'] != ''
  ),
  per_repo AS (
    SELECT kind, repo, max(at_ms) AS last_ms
    FROM records
    WHERE kind IN (SELECT kind FROM registry WHERE scope != 'fleet_wide') AND repo != ''
    GROUP BY kind, repo
  ),
  expected AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT kind, repo FROM (
      SELECT g.kind AS kind, r.repo AS repo
      FROM registry AS g
      CROSS JOIN roster AS r
      WHERE g.scope = 'per_repo'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT kind, repo FROM per_repo)
  ),
  items AS (
    SELECT kind, repo, issue, max(at_ms) AS last_ms, argMax(refused, at_ms) AS refused_now
    FROM records
    WHERE kind IN (SELECT kind FROM registry WHERE scope = 'per_active_repo')
    GROUP BY kind, repo, issue
  ),
  closures AS (
    SELECT g.kind AS kind, c.repo AS repo, c.issue AS issue, max(c.at_ms) AS closed_ms
    FROM records AS c
    INNER JOIN registry AS g ON c.kind = g.closed_by
    WHERE c.eta_kind = 'land'
    GROUP BY kind, repo, issue
  ),
  owing AS (
    SELECT i.kind AS kind, i.repo AS repo,
           max(NOT i.refused_now
               AND NOT (c.closed_ms > 0 AND c.closed_ms + g.deadline_sec * 1000 >= i.last_ms)) AS owed
    FROM items AS i
    INNER JOIN registry AS g ON i.kind = g.kind
    LEFT JOIN closures AS c ON i.kind = c.kind AND i.repo = c.repo AND i.issue = c.issue
    GROUP BY kind, repo
  ),
  series AS (
    SELECT g.kind AS kind, '' AS repo, g.deadline_sec AS deadline_sec,
           if(g.scope = 'fleet_wide', max(p.at_ms), 0) AS last_ms,
           countIf(p.kind != '') AS seen,
           1 AS judged
    FROM registry AS g
    LEFT JOIN records AS p ON p.kind = g.kind
    GROUP BY g.kind, g.scope, g.deadline_sec
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.kind, e.repo, g.deadline_sec, r.last_ms, if(r.last_ms > 0, 1, 0),
           if(g.scope = 'per_active_repo', o.owed, 1)
    FROM expected AS e
    INNER JOIN registry AS g ON e.kind = g.kind
    LEFT JOIN per_repo AS r ON e.kind = r.kind AND e.repo = r.repo
    LEFT JOIN owing AS o ON e.kind = o.kind AND e.repo = o.repo
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       kind,
       repo,
       toFloat64(multiIf(
         seen = 0, intDiv(end_ms - start_ms, 1000),
         judged = 0 OR (repo = '' AND last_ms = 0), 0,
         intDiv(end_ms - last_ms, 1000)) - deadline_sec) AS value
FROM series
ORDER BY kind, repo

annotations.description: The fleet singleton output {{$labels.kind}} (repo {{$labels.repo}}; empty means the whole fleet) is {{$value}} s past its deadline. Each deadline is 2 x the row's cadence in loom-daemon's fleet_outputs::SINGLETON_OUTPUTS (or the row's own override), embedded in the query and kept equal to it by signoz_fleet_singleton_output_alert.rs. This rule checks the OUTPUT, never which host owns the job, so a job that moved to a host that does not produce it (or has no OTLP exporter) fires the same as a stalled one. An output with no record at all in the 72 h window fires. A per-repo output (eta.fleet_refresh) is expected for every repo the fleet is working on, read from an independent signal: any repo with a pass.summary, role_tick.outcome or sweep.started record in the window. Such a repo with no output in the window fires, so a repo the producing host does not cover, or an outage older than the window, stays visible while that activity continues. Find the producing host with `loom-daemon eta doctor` (ETA rows) or the fleet captain's armed singleton jobs, and check that it has an OTLP exporter. Issue #10916 (incident 2026-10-07/08: 28 of ~30 repos had no eta.estimate for ~31 h while every host looked healthy).
